token_pruning_core.description: Training-free visual-token pruning for a frozen LLaVA-1.5-7B (576 CLIP ViT-L/14-336 tokens per image). Scored quantity: accuracy of the frozen model with the pruned tokens divided by its accuracy with all 576 tokens, averaged over question families (the paper's 'Avg.' relative performance). Budgets: 64 tokens (the paper's most aggressive LLaVA-1.5 setting, 88.9% reduction) and 32 tokens (more aggressive). Benchmark: COCO val2017 questions (POPE-protocol existence, counting, caption matching, absent-object choice) instead of the paper's nine benchmarks; same model, budget and metric definition. Paper values below are Table 1 (LLaVA-1.5-7B, 64 tokens, Avg. over VQAv2/GQA/SQA/TextVQA/POPE/MME/MMB/MMB-CN/MM-Vet); the paper has no 32-token LLaVA-1.5 numbers and no local/global split.

performance_retained.description: 64-token budget: mean over the four question families of (accuracy with pruned tokens) / (accuracy with all 576 tokens) of the same frozen model.

performance_retained_32.description: Same relative performance at the 32-token budget (94.4% reduction), where pruning methods diverge most.

local_evidence_retained.description: 64-token relative performance on the families answered from specific objects (existence, counting).

global_context_retained.description: 64-token relative performance on the families that need whole-scene coverage (caption matching, absent-object choice).
